title: Seventeenth
summary: SEV'ENTEENTH, adjective [from seventeen.] The ordinal of seventeen; the seventh after the tenth. On the seventeenth day of the second month- all the fountains of the great deep were broken up. Genesis

inlines.v: SEV'ENTEENTH, adjective [from seventeen.] The ordinal of seventeen; the seventh after the tenth. On the seventeenth day of the second month- all the fountains of the great deep were broken up. Genesis 7:11.
